requirement: DanceFlow policy: approval needs a different manager than the calculator, or the calculator's audited override reason (1-500 chars); no override exists for the minimum-two-couples rule, the Final withdrawal/exclusion windows, exclusion or withdrawal co-sign separation of duties, or approval of a stale result; approval is manager-only; API access is authenticated-only.
enforcement_point: approve_competition_round_result (F2 + A3 roster check + PV-1 re-verify); A5/A6 request and co-sign RPCs.

tests.name: refuses a stale result BEFORE the override branch, so an override reason can never approve a stale result

interpretation_notes: Inspected plus static tests (executed); SQL suites f2_results, a4_minimum_integration, a5_exclusion, a6_withdrawal NOT RUN. Gaps: no test that a chair is refused approve; none that an override reason fails against a stale hash; none that the roster-minimum code surfaces at approve independently of STALE; none for service_role (approve revokes only public/anon, unlike A5/A6; not exploitable since auth.uid() is null); approve does not check a verified email for the approver; override reason is not required to be substantive (A5/A6 are).
